title: Prove filtered list returns copies
action: Phase 2 verification found that the copy guarantee of the FILTERED list path rests on code reading alone. Add one test to tests/todo.test.mjs that takes s.list({priority:'high'})[0], writes to .title and .done, then re-reads s.list({priority:'high'}) and asserts the store value is unchanged. Write it so it would fail if list() returned live references from the filtered branch.
acceptance: a test mutates an item from a filtered list and asserts the store is unchanged
the test would fail if the filtered branch returned live references
